title: Speaker
description: Defines the required metadata for every pseudonymous speaker profile in the Sauti Labs platform, per ADR-0002. This schema intentionally excludes all personally identifying information (name, contact details, exact location, date of birth, photographs) by design. Operational identity management (consent forms, contact records) lives in a separate secure system entirely outside this repository.

speaker_id.description: Pseudonymous identifier, e.g. 'spk-a1b2c3d4'. Never a real name or derivable from one.

languages.description: ISO codes of languages this speaker speaks, cross-referenced to Codex Layer 2.

dialect_region.description: Broad dialect or regional area only, e.g. 'Alego, Kenya' or 'Zanzibar coastal'. Never a village name or GPS coordinate.

age_range.description: Broad age bracket only. Exact date of birth must never be recorded in this schema.

consent.description: Structured consent governance object, per ADR-0002. Consent is never a simple boolean.

scope.description: Permitted uses. A speaker may consent to some uses and not others.

consent_agreement_version.description: Version identifier of the consent agreement text, e.g. 'v1.0'. Required once status is 'obtained'.

contributed_recording_ids.description: Cross-reference to speech-registry recording entries this speaker contributed to.
